definitions.explanation: A dish of thick udon noodles stir-fried with vegetables, meat, and sauce. Similar in concept to yakisoba but using udon noodles instead.

examples.japanese: {焼|や}きうどん⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
{昼|ひる}ごはん⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{焼|や}きうどん⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べた→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
examples.english: I had fried udon for lunch.

examples.japanese: ⟦{冷蔵庫|れいぞうこ}→冷蔵庫：01046_reizouko⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{残|のこ}り{物|もの}→残り物：18299_nokorimono⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{焼|や}きうどん⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}ったら→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧、⟦{意外|いがい}→意外：12741_igai⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧おいしかった。
examples.english: I made fried udon with leftover ingredients from the fridge, and it was surprisingly good.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{焼|や}き→焼く：01123_yaku⟧ (fried, grilled) + ⟦うどん→うどん：05182_udon⟧ (thick wheat noodles). A popular home-cooked and street-food dish in Japan.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {焼|や}きうどん⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧: to make fried udon
- ⟦ソース→ソース：17673_soosu⟧{焼|や}きうどん: sauce-flavored fried udon
- ⟦{醤油|しょうゆ}→醤油：01056_shouyu⟧{焼|や}きうどん: soy sauce-flavored fried udon

PREPARATION:
Typically made by stir-frying udon noodles in a hot pan with ingredients like ⟦{豚肉|ぶたにく}→豚肉：02956_butaniku⟧ (pork), ⟦キャベツ→キャベツ：05187_kyabetsu⟧ (cabbage), ⟦{人参|にんじん}→人参：05185_ninjin⟧ (carrot), and ⟦もやし→もやし：10645_moyashi⟧ (bean sprouts), seasoned with soy sauce or Worcestershire-style sauce.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{焼|や}きそば→焼きそば：13405_yakisoba⟧: fried soba-style noodles (thinner, more common street food)
- ⟦うどん→うどん：05182_udon⟧: thick wheat noodles (the base ingredient)
- ⟦{鉄板焼|てっぱんや}き→鉄板焼き：10181_teppanyaki⟧: teppanyaki — {焼|や}きうどん is sometimes served on a hot plate

CULTURAL NOTE:
{焼|や}きうどん is said to have originated in the city of {小倉|こくら} in Kitakyushu. It is a common quick meal at home and a popular item at ⟦{屋台|やたい}→屋台：10549_yatai⟧ (food stalls) and ⟦{居酒屋|いざかや}→居酒屋：09635_izakaya⟧.
